L22: # FOR OWNERS
L23: ###### INITIAL CONSULTATION
L24: 
L25: $250
L26: We will book a one-hour phone call/video chat to discuss your pet’s cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment options. Your pet’s medical records need to be attached at the time of scheduling. Within 24 hours of the consultation both you and your veterinarian will receive an email, including information about your pet’s cancer, and potential treatment options.
